fields.summary: Autonomous plan run, no owner present, so no owner words are quoted. The change set's intent: rhiza run findings numbers each finding f1, f2, ... from a count read in the run, so two concurrent calls in one session can journal the same ID. Planned outcome: findings are numbered under the run's lock, for the round, --check and leaf findings and the sign-off findings alike. Decisions below are the planner's assumptions, not owner decisions; the owner has not confirmed them.
fields.title: Findings numbering under the run's lock
